departures.caller_effect: Service destruction/close and its context close owned transport but do not DELETE temporary server lists; those lists can remain on the server.
departures.reason: Avoid network mutation during nondeterministic garbage collection; shared native lifecycle remains explicit.
departures.recommendation: Use a ListManager context or delete_temporary_lists(); for the internal Service manager call Service.flush() before closing. A Service context alone does not delete server lists.

departures.caller_effect: dataframe returns polars.DataFrame in both profiles rather than pandas.DataFrame; pandas methods/index semantics do not transfer.
departures.reason: Required lazy Polars -> Parquet -> DuckDB SQL -> Arrow -> Polars pipeline with explicit CSV only.
departures.recommendation: Use Polars expressions and explicit CSV inputs/exports; analytics extra remains an alias.

departures.caller_effect: Nested grouping preserves markers; B OR ((A OR C) AND D) may evaluate differently from the buggy upstream parse.
departures.reason: Preserve intended parentheses and truth values.
departures.recommendation: Keep explicit parentheses; do not rely on upstream marker loss.

departures.caller_effect: next(sort_orders) returns the first order without consuming; upstream raises TypeError.
departures.reason: Retain native repaired container behavior.
departures.recommendation: Use iter(sort_orders) for normal advancing iteration.

departures.caller_effect: Borrowed streams stay open; invalid schemas raise public errors and inheritance resolves independently of declaration order.
departures.reason: Repair leaks, cleanup crashes and order-dependent model state.
departures.recommendation: Handle ModelParseError/ModelError and explicitly own borrowed input lifetimes.

departures.caller_effect: Composed classes include ancestors of every component, not only the final one.
departures.reason: Repair ancestor loss.
departures.recommendation: Use the complete parent set for isa decisions.

departures.caller_effect: Hash follows string equality; navigating beyond attributes raises PathParseError rather than an internal AttributeError.
departures.reason: Consistent mapping keys and public model errors.
departures.recommendation: Catch PathParseError and treat paths as stable string-valued keys.

departures.caller_effect: Codes include Z, continue beyond Z and skip reserved codes; invalid/duplicate calls reject before state mutation.
departures.reason: Repair source exhaustion/collision and avoid repeated uploads.
departures.recommendation: Retain generated codes rather than assuming a 25-code ceiling.

departures.caller_effect: Multi/Range/ISA values normalize to string lists rather than preserving input collection type and scalar types.
departures.reason: Retain established native normalization through shared constraints.
departures.recommendation: Use serialized values as strings; retain original typed inputs separately.

departures.caller_effect: Bound selections clone and retain filters/refinements; reference-relative fields resolve beneath that reference.
departures.reason: Repair lost query state and wrong reference roots.
departures.recommendation: Create a fresh model/service query explicitly when a fresh filter state is desired.

departures.caller_effect: Native service queries retain string roots/columns and dictionary results/rows; the webservice facade and direct Query(Model) select legacy model/objects/ResultRows.
departures.reason: Preserve existing native callers while restoring the original API through an explicit profile.
departures.recommendation: Use intermine314.webservice.Service for legacy defaults or select compatibility explicitly.

departures.caller_effect: Service-loaded queries remain bound; XML uses canonical pathString, preserves empty values and rejects unknown logic instead of deleting codes.
departures.reason: Repair unexecutable loads and malformed server XML.
departures.recommendation: Use canonical pathString; correct invalid logic instead of relying on silent repair.

departures.caller_effect: Mixed descriptor roots/refinements are normalized together; conflicting roots and unsupported combinations raise public errors before HTTP.
departures.reason: Avoid silently dropped selections and invalid model paths.
departures.recommendation: Choose a common compatible root and pass supported descriptors/XML forms.

departures.caller_effect: Unicode registration values are real form strings instead of upstream Python 3 bytearray representations; configured transport is preserved.
departures.reason: Repair encoded account data and resource ownership.
departures.recommendation: Pass Unicode strings and close separately owned returned Services.

departures.caller_effect: String tokens containing uuid stay strings; validity errors describe implemented 1..86400 seconds.
departures.reason: Repair accidental token indexing and misleading error range.
departures.recommendation: Supply string tokens or token dictionaries and validity in seconds.

departures.caller_effect: Empty rows stringify safely instead of indexing absent first cells.
departures.reason: Repair empty-row representation crash.
departures.recommendation: Treat empty row text as a valid representation.

departures.caller_effect: JSON null is yielded, not an end marker; streams close on completion, explicit close, failures and interruptions.
departures.reason: Repair lost null data and response leaks while retaining shared opener behavior.
departures.recommendation: Explicitly close early-stopped streams and allow null rows in raw JSON modes.

departures.caller_effect: Missing class metadata falls back; missing/null/no-ID fields avoid spurious fetches; noncontiguous paths and cycles are preserved safely.
departures.reason: Repair lost object data, id=None requests and recursion.
departures.recommendation: Expect stable cached None/empty collections and bounded representations.

departures.caller_effect: Byte and BigDecimal summaries use server numeric statistics and size=0 is forwarded; returned summary numbers remain floats.
departures.reason: Align with server numeric classification and explicit pagination.
departures.recommendation: Use dataframe/export for exact Decimal analytics rather than float summary values.

departures.caller_effect: Generator/readable uploads work without len; iterable identifiers escape quotes and reject line breaks; CSV IDs stay strings and reject null/empty entries.
departures.reason: Repair linewise tokenizer corruption and identifier loss.
departures.recommendation: Use explicit csv_column and valid nonempty single-line identifiers; borrowed streams stay open.

departures.caller_effect: Caches publish after successful complete refresh; reserved names are skipped and renaming retires old temporary ownership.
departures.reason: Avoid partial cache mutation and accidental deletion/reuse.
departures.recommendation: Retry failed refresh and use returned names rather than predicting allocations.

departures.caller_effect: Cleanup snapshots names, retires successful deletes individually and preserves the body exception with notes on cleanup failure.
departures.reason: Allow safe retry without mutable-set errors or masking the primary failure.
departures.recommendation: Retry remaining temporary names; inspect exception notes for cleanup failures.

departures.caller_effect: Display reads fields directly and closes its result stream if printing fails.
departures.reason: Avoid parsing punctuation from object string representations and leaking streams.
departures.recommendation: Do not depend on punctuation parsing side effects.

departures.caller_effect: Uploads project a clone and reject foreign/unbound operands, ambiguous IDs and semicolon list names before mutations.
departures.reason: Avoid modifying query views or accidentally resolving a foreign list as a local name.
departures.recommendation: Use same-root operands with one entity ID projection and delimiter-safe list names.

departures.caller_effect: Historical calls stream EnrichmentLine; explicit output_path materializes typed atomic Parquet/CSV and returns detached Polars.
departures.reason: Add the required analytics pipeline without implicit output.
departures.recommendation: Request output_path and format explicitly; close early-stopped historical streams.

departures.caller_effect: Python boolean True is editable and invalid optional state rejects before list upload.
departures.reason: Repair source string-only boolean comparison and premature side effects.
departures.recommendation: Use booleans or canonical XML strings with valid locked/on/off optional state.

departures.caller_effect: Inactive constraints are omitted; unsupported active editable loop/subclass/range/ISA and empty multi values reject before HTTP; adjustments are validated and cloned.
departures.reason: Repair broken server forms and unrestricted attribute mutation.
departures.recommendation: Set unsupported saved constraints editable=False or switch optional constraints off; use supported adjustment fields.

departures.caller_effect: Serialized templates retain wrapper metadata/editable flags; inherited list operations use actual template endpoints and ID path projection.
departures.reason: Repair metadata loss and Query XML sent to named-template endpoints.
departures.recommendation: Retain Template type during cloning and use the shared list APIs.

departures.caller_effect: User templates cache by owner/name; name/object views share an XML snapshot; duplicate names within an owner reject.
departures.reason: Repair top-level cache overwrite, redundant GETs and silent duplicate loss.
departures.recommendation: Use flush to refresh the snapshot; handle duplicate-name ServiceError.

departures.caller_effect: A null UID raises Exception(No uid found), replacing upstream accidental string-plus-dictionary TypeError.
departures.reason: Provide the intended job-construction failure.
departures.recommendation: Handle failed submissions and inspect server error payloads.

departures.caller_effect: Equivalent empty saved-queries XML including self-closing/whitespace forms returns the historical missing-query result.
departures.reason: Repair literal-only sentinel detection.
departures.recommendation: Treat semantically empty saved-query XML as no query.

departures.caller_effect: Helpers preserve configured managed transport, encode account/query values, close owned state and accept explicit overwrite controls.
departures.reason: Repair raw URL concatenation and unowned clients without changing historical default prompts.
departures.recommendation: Use explicit overwrite for unattended saved-query updates and supplied clients for transport policy.

departures.caller_effect: The final TSV record is split even without trailing LF; LF still yields the historical final empty-string sentinel.
departures.reason: Repair unsplit/lost final row.
departures.recommendation: Handle row arrays and optional final sentinel.

departures.caller_effect: Selected token authenticates private enrichment; streams close at five records without reading sixth/footer; malformed data raises ValueError.
departures.reason: Repair missing authentication, excessive consumption and indexing crashes.
departures.recommendation: Use full enrichment APIs when footer validation/all results are required.

departures.caller_effect: Lazy Polars replaces pandas/owned NumPy math; invalid input raises ValueError before figures; nonfinite artists remain inspectable but invisible.
departures.reason: Required no-pandas analytics and safe Matplotlib rendering.
departures.recommendation: Install the plots extra; expect None return and inspect finite chart heights.

departures.caller_effect: The native configured HTTPS registry endpoint replaces the source hard-coded HTTP default; injected registries remain borrowed.
departures.reason: Preserve configured secure transport and deterministic ownership.
departures.recommendation: Use registry_url for a custom registry and close only resources you own.

departures.caller_effect: Text remains str rather than becoming UTF-8 bytes; numeric/None/bool values stringify; list/tuple mapping values normalize element-wise to lists for doseq. Binary values remain bytes.
departures.reason: Retain established managed transport scalar forms and correct repeated form values without silently changing native requests.
departures.recommendation: Pass the mapping to urlencode(..., doseq=True). Call .encode("utf-8") explicitly when an API requires bytes; preserve typed input data separately.

departures.caller_effect: headers() emits standard User-Agent instead of the upstream misspelled UserAgent; a configured user_agent overrides the default. Auth/Content-Type/Accept remain optional.
departures.reason: Use the standard HTTP header and shared configurable transport policy.
departures.recommendation: Read or customize User-Agent/user_agent; update consumers that expected the literal nonstandard UserAgent key.

departures.caller_effect: A -> B -> C -> D returns [B,C,D], where upstream iteration over its extended list returned [B,C,D,D]. Diamond branches can still repeat a shared ancestor; cycles raise ModelError.
departures.reason: Avoid re-expanding ancestors accidentally appended to the active traversal while retaining branch order.
departures.recommendation: Do not count accidental upstream repetitions as distinct ancestors. Deduplicate by class identity/name if set semantics are desired; handle cycle errors.
